name: jcc_storybook
description: Storybook driven drupal theme JCC Storybook

scripts.lib: rm -rf lib/stories && babel src -d lib --ignore 'src/stories/**/*.stories.js,src/stories/**/*.data.js',src/assets --presets=@babel/preset-env --plugins=babel-plugin-drupal-behaviors && npm run minify-js && npm run minify-css
scripts.minify-js: find lib -type f -name '*.js' ! -path 'lib/webpack.config.js' ! -path 'lib/loaders.js' ! -path 'lib/plugins.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -I{} terser {} --compress --mangle --ecma 2015 --comments false -o {}
scripts.sprite: svg-sprite -s --symbol-dest src/assets/ --symbol-sprite icons.svg src/assets/icons/*.svg && node src/assets/iconsJSON.js src/assets/icons

author: JCC Web Services
